title: Public key infrastructure (PKI), certificates and the chain of trust

videos.script: A signature proves who signed, if you already know whose key you hold. On the internet, you almost never do. {{gap}} A certificate authority closes that gap. It signs a statement: this key belongs to this name, for this long. {{cert}} In this lesson you run one. You will read the company's three certificates and see why the root signs only once. You will walk a chain by hand, and break it by leaving out the middle link. {{chain}} Then you will issue a certificate for an internal service, and take it back when its key is lost. {{revoke}} Last, what keeps an authority from becoming the weakest point of the network it protects. {{run}}
